description: The reading order against the source order (RB-094-02): the outline plugin's rule `reading-order` (plugins/outline/src/rules/reading.rs) and the tab order overlay's reading arrows (plugins/overlays/web/src/overlays/tab-order/reading.ts) decide these cases alike. Each case: the boxes [x, y, width, height] in CSS px in source order, the content's direction, the tolerance in px, and the places (from 0) of the elements that show before the one before them in the source.

cases.name: order -1 on the second of three buttons
right to left content reading from the right
right to left content laid out left to right
a column to the right is read after the left one
a column to the left is read first
two elements in the same box
